addendum_required_before_start: O2.13 post-seal descriptive addendum committed + O2_13_STATUS_UNCHANGED
question: Is the established 8-observation target-imagery calibration requirement ROBUST to acquisition-schedule variability (WHICH identities / WHICH repeats)?

primary_model.estimator: EXACT O2.9 no-prior operational estimator (direct target-state SVD; D=2 outside; q=min(M,r_best) within; sealed W_target; O2.7 trial residual state)

acquisition_schedule.definition: one frozen balanced identity subset x one frozen repeat-position subset, within subject x ROI x fold x M x T

schedule_eval.fit: exact O2.9 estimator from ONLY that calibration schedule; evaluate on the same TWO held-out identities for the fold

schedule_success: SCHEDULE_SUFFICIENT iff TOTAL_SCHEDULE>=0.50 AND FCF_SCHEDULE>=0.50 (no p-value)

participant_coverage.SCHEDULE_COVERAGE: mean over 6 folds of SCHEDULE_COVERAGE_FOLD (equal fold weight)

robust_cell.SCHEDULE_ROBUST_SUFFICIENT: ALL: (1) historical O2.9 participant-average operational criterion satisfied in that ROI; (2) median participant SCHEDULE_COVERAGE>=0.75; (3) >=6/8 participants SCHEDULE_COVERAGE>=0.75
robust_cell.rationale: conservative operational robustness benchmark (NOT biological); no alternative percentages tested

common_robust: COMMON_SCHEDULE_ROBUST_SUCCESS iff SCHEDULE_ROBUST_SUFFICIENT in BOTH ventral and lateral

robust_minimum.N_TRIALS_ROBUST_STAR: min(M*T) over common robust cells (separate from historical N_TRIALS_STAR=8)

variance_decomposition.Y: TOTAL_SCHEDULE on crossed identity(i) x repeat(r) grid per subject/ROI/fold/cell

repeat_position_diagnostic.per_pair: average over 100 identity subsets, then participant-first over folds; report recovery/coverage

identity_subset_diagnostic.per_subset: average over 28 repeat pairs; report recovery/success

outer_fold_lofo.criterion: M4T2_LOFO_STABLE iff M4T2 remains operationally sufficient in BOTH ROIs under ALL six LOFO (original O2.9 rule)

participant_jackknife.per_omitted_participant: group medians + schedule coverage among remaining 7

DIRECT_TARGET_IMAGERY_NECESSITY_SUPPORTE: 1 no sealed N=0 method reached operational sufficiency
2 no sealed sub-eight O2.9 cell reached common operational sufficiency
3 O2.12 did not establish prior-enabled sub-eight sufficiency
4 O2.13 established no reproducible tested covariate structure
5 M4T2 remains common operationally sufficient on exact replay
direct_necessity_checklist.bounded: program-level; does NOT mean target imagery is theoretically necessary

primary_status.EIGHT_TRIAL_TARGET_IMAGERY_CALIBRATION_R: M4T2 common schedule-robust AND LOFO stable AND no common robust cell <8
primary_status.SUBEIGHT_SCHEDULE_ROBUST_CALIBRATION_EME: a <8 cell meets the frozen robustness criterion (records new robustness result; does not rewrite O2.9)
primary_status.EIGHT_TRIAL_MINIMUM_AVERAGE_ONLY_NOT_SCH: M4T2 keeps historical average sufficiency but fails schedule robustness or LOFO stability

program_status.EIGHT_TRIAL_CALIBRATION_ROBUST_WITHOUT_N: eight-trial schedule robustness passes but a necessity prerequisite does not
program_status.else: corresponding average-only / multiregime / subeight / inconclusive result

no_primary_pvalue: robustness/resource-validation gate; participant remains the unit; schedules are NOT independent subjects

completeness_counts.per: subject x ROI x fold; any missing -> that participant/cell technical failure; no classification from incomplete sets

claim_boundaries.positive_robust: within the tested representation and fixed direct target-state estimator, the 8-observation M4T2 calibration remained operationally sufficient across >=75% of prospectively valid acquisition schedules for the required participant majority and was stable to outer-fold omission
claim_boundaries.positive_necessity: across the tested donor-transfer, perception-only, low-dim covariate, prior-assisted, and direct-imagery methods, direct target imagery remained necessary for operational recovery, with 8 observations the smallest robustly sufficient tested burden
forbidden: no future non-imagery method can work

next_gate.NECESSITY_ROBUST_AT_EIGHT: O2.15 INDEPENDENT PROSPECTIVE REPLICATION OF THE EIGHT-TRIAL PROTOCOL (M4,T2,D2, direct within-support estimator, same thresholds; independent cohort/dataset/new participants; do NOT subdivide same N=8)
next_gate.AVERAGE_ONLY_NOT_ROBUST: O2.15 ACQUISITION-SCHEDULE FAILURE-MODE DIAGNOSTIC (use frozen variance decomposition; do not optimize schedule on same data)
next_gate.SUBEIGHT_ROBUST_EMERGES: O2.15 PROSPECTIVE REPLICATION OF THE SUBEIGHT ROBUST CELL

O3_policy: even a robust O2.14 does NOT unlock O3; independent prospective replication required before any stronger operator claim
